The '''Jalarren system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Its most notable life supporting [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Jalarren]], the second [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] of its yellow ([[Star/Legends|Type-G]]) sun.
